request.subject: ICON:ACTION:SWARM

layers.text: Change only the blade: snap the sword's blade clean in two in its middle, so the tip half lies a little apart from the half on the hilt with a clear gap between them, the broken ends jagged. Keep the two teal spade-tipped tails curled round it, the hilt, the grey steel colour, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
